content: The Events Calendar REST /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events (source master): per_page max 50 (filter tribe_rest_event_max_per_page), page beyond end returns WP_Error 404 event-archive-page-not-found, headers X-TEC-Total / X-TEC-TotalPages, body next_rest_url/total_pages; default window start 'yesterday 23:59' to +24 months; inclusive day bounds unless strict_dates. Fields: start_date local, utc_start_date, timezone, all_day, description is filtered HTML, cost string, venue object.
